label: Bible Study
prompt: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the _____ God.
verse: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
note: Peter's great confession at Caesarea Philippi — Jesus blessed him for it on the spot.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For there is hope of a _____, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verse: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
note: Even a cut-down tree may sprout again — Job's picture of hope that won't stay stumped.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But withal prepare me also a _____: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
verse: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
note: Paul ends his note to Philemon hopeful of release: get a lodging ready for me.

label: Deep Water
note: Four words, one picture: the Spirit as a fire you can smother — so don't.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor _____; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verse: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
note: The Servant had 'no form nor comeliness' — nothing in his looks to draw a crowd.
